reuse.why: Reuses getDateWithSkippedWeekend (extended with holidays), recurConfigToRSchedule and RSchedule, but the daily-skip rule is not put in a shared helper and getDatesInRange rebuilds the getUpcomingDates pipeline rather than sharing it.

duplication.why: The daily weekend/holiday skip rule is written twice (a retry loop in getNextDate and a null-map filter in getDatesInRange), and getDatesInRange copies the RSchedule/occurrences/breadcrumb skeleton of getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: Holiday matching and the weekend move live in shared/schedules.ts where they belong, but the daily-skip decision is placed inside getNextDate and inline in the server handler instead of in the weekend-adjustment helper.

scope.why: Edits stay on schedules, recur config typing and the new handler; tests are related.

maintainability.why: The weekend rule now has three variants (move in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, skip loop in getNextDate, skip filter in getDatesInRange) and getUpcomingDates/schedule-template still only move, so future rule changes must be found in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts decides daily skipping inline (isWeekend/isHoliday) around getDateWithSkippedWeekend; getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts call getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly without the daily rule.

disguised_duplication.where: Daily skip rule appears as a bounded for-loop over occurrences in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and as a map-to-null + filter(Boolean) in server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange; getDatesInRange reshapes getUpcomingDates (range window instead of count).

abstraction_drift.where: holidays parameter added to getDateWithSkippedWeekend; DAILY special-case branch added inside getNextDate; getDatesInRange re-implements the daily skip, and getUpcomingDates and schedule-template's two calls bypass it (counted as getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template).
